name: Kazaoka Haruaki
source: Haruaki has fallen on hard times at his work place. While drinking alone he meets Rio who he has a one night affair with was the one who told him about a inn in the country side. Deciding to go to get away from his troubles. Along the way he meets Michiru the single mother who offers him a ride to the inn,Kasumi his childhood friend who is the owner of the inn and Rio who he met at the bar traveling alone who is also staying at the inn.
